summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved plan: setup dependency/index network failures are classified with redacted bounded metadata, setup-only transient failures retry with bounded backoff and preserved artifacts/lineage, executor emits retry/exhaustion events and precise terminal reason codes, deterministic failures remain non-retryable, and recorded focused pytest/ruff/mypy evidence covers the original DNS regression plus the iteration-1 transient-shape and command-redaction gaps.
